text: What do you think? Me too.
So, what's your opinion of Copenhagen?
I think it's amazing. The canal is beautiful, and the people are friendly.
I agree. But I think it's very expensive.
Me too. My sandwich yesterday was twenty dollars!
Ha! And the Little Mermaid? Do you still think it's boring?
Yes, sorry. I don't think it's interesting. It's a very small statue.
I don't agree, but OK. And the bridge at night?
Oh, I think that was beautiful. What a view.
I think so too. So, tomorrow: the palace or a boat tour?
I think the boat tour is a good idea. What do you think?
I agree. The boat tour, then, and lunch by the canal.
Perfect. And this time, I'll pay.
I think so too. What do you think?
I don't agree, but that's OK.

My husband and I were in Rome last month, and we don't always agree. I think Rome is beautiful, but he thinks it's too hot in the summer. OK, I agree with him about that! The food? We both think it's amazing. The museums? I think they are very interesting, but he doesn't think so. He thinks they are boring and very crowded. Our hotel was small, but I think it was cozy. He didn't agree. He thinks it was noisy. So, what's my opinion of the trip? I think it was great. And his opinion? He says: next time, Copenhagen!

Hello, everyone, and welcome to the canal tour. On your left is Nyhavn. These houses are three hundred years old. I think they are beautiful, and I hope you agree. Now we go under a small bridge, so please sit down! In front of us is the Opera House. Some people think it is ugly. I don't think so. I think it's amazing, especially at night. And now, on the right, the Little Mermaid. Many visitors say she is small and a little boring. What do you think? In my opinion, she is small, but she is the symbol of the city. The tour ends in twenty minutes. Enjoy the view!

We walked to the old canal, and Claire said, I think it's beautiful. I said, I agree. It's amazing. Then we walked over a long bridge to see the Little Mermaid. I said, I don't think it's interesting. It's a very small statue. Claire didn't agree. She thinks the statue is beautiful.
The statue? I don't think it's interesting.
